description: Header file defining the VaapiJpegEncodeAccelerator class, which provides hardware-accelerated JPEG encoding support on Intel systems using VAAPI. It includes class declarations, method signatures, and member variables related to JPEG encoding tasks, threading, and client interaction.

classes.name: VaapiJpegEncodeAccelerator
classes.description: Provides hardware-accelerated JPEG encoding for Intel systems with VAAPI support, managing encoding tasks on a separate thread, and interacting with clients via callbacks.

classes.name: EncodeRequest
classes.description: Represents a JPEG encoding request, including input video frame, output buffers, and quality settings.

classes.name: Encoder
classes.description: A nested class responsible for executing encoding operations on a dedicated thread.

methods.name: VaapiJpegEncodeAccelerator
methods.description: Constructor initializing the encoder with a specified IO thread.

methods.name: InitializeAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously initializes the encoder with a client and callback.

methods.name: GetMaxCodedBufferSize
methods.description: Returns the maximum buffer size needed for a given picture size.

methods.name: Encode
methods.description: Starts encoding a video frame with specified quality and buffers.

methods.name: EncodeWithDmaBuf
methods.description: Encodes a video frame using DMA buffers, with additional task ID.

methods.name: NotifyError
methods.description: Notifies the client of an encoding error.

methods.name: VideoFrameReady
methods.description: Indicates that a video frame has been encoded and is ready.
